propositions: The idempotency integration test patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and related operations to binding_lifecycle which resolves its own _now_iso, causing the patch to no longer reach those operations.
The test still passes but its blast radius narrowed—it would not catch a regression where moved operations stamp updated_at unconditionally.
Unit-tier coverage exists at test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, but integration-tier mutation detection was weakened by the refactoring.
AC#1 requires patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle to restore integration oracle reach.
AC#2 (seeded mutation of unconditional clear_absent stamp) is unsatisfiable on healthy in-window passes because clear_absent is structurally unreachable in the idempotency fixture.
